name: roastmarket
description: German online shop for coffee and espresso beans, coffee machines including fully automatic and portafilter machines, grinders and coffee accessories. Its shipping page lists Germany among 23 delivery countries, usually delivered within 1 to 2 working days.
description_es: Tienda online alemana de café y espresso, cafeteras (automáticas y de portafiltro), molinillos y accesorios. Su página de envíos incluye Alemania entre 23 países de entrega, con entrega habitual en 1 a 2 días hábiles.

ships_to.notes: Germany is listed on the shipping page with no regional or island limits stated. Parcel locker and post office delivery is offered.

fulfillment.pickup_notes: Online orders are not described as collectable. A flagship store in Frankfurt am Main is listed, but pickup of online orders there is not stated.

shopping_notes: Coffee and accessories ship for 4.90 EUR under a 49 EUR order value and free above it. Machines and freight goods have separate rates.

sources.supports: delivery countries including Germany, carriers, delivery times
